sections.title: Correlated collection echoes
sections.text: Graph capture and preflight use the same canonical forward inventory. A documentReferences entry is normalized into its owned Derive edge only with a single otherwise unidentified collection reference and a single unsuppressed owned Derive, matching owner/referenced native documents, source project/file and exact version. The Derive retains collectionEcho proof. Self references, ordinary occurrence uses, multiple references/Derives or pins, explicit identities and missing evidence are preserved, not collapsed by filename or file ID alone. The collection echo may disappear after cold reopen; all planned canonical edges still require exact verification. Existing plans and failed receipts are immutable: use a fresh audit/plan, not a replay of a failed request.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: schemaVersion:1 result with invocationStatus:complete|partial|blocked|failed|unknown, success, modelValidated, graphComplete, allIntendedReferencesCurrent and allReferencesLatest (each true|false|null), documents, edges, order, completed/skipped/blocked/failed/notProcessed, inProgress, budgetExceeded, continuation, lifecycleEffects, environment and errors. Document records distinguish baselineVersion/resultingVersion, identityBefore/After, method, saveStatus, coldVerified and checks; edge records distinguish observed/baseline/target/latest versions and binding evidence. inspect reports local receipts only and modelValidated:false. An unknown submission is not a resumable success; a completed UI action is not a model result.

sections.title: Forward graph and evidence
sections.text: The refresh DAG is built only from Document.documentReferences plus unsuppressed Derive features owned by traversed local components. Never traverse referenced/derived geometry as if it were locally owned. DataFile.childReferences is not a DAG: it can point in the reverse direction or expose stale version metadata. It may supplement a version getter only after a unique forward edge is already proved. Keep getter error, saved edge version, latest version, derived binding/value, feature health, geometry response, cloud completion and cold reopen as distinct evidence. `2 : InternalValidationError : doc` is diagnostic, neither corruption proof nor PASS; parameter-only and body-source cases have both produced real responses despite such errors.

sections.title: Phases, pins and lifecycle
sections.text: audit (default) observes; plan requires explicit policy preserve|latest and writes a checksum-verified immutable local plan; apply requires planId+confirm:true and one operation authorization; inspect reads only local receipts/plan and must make zero Fusion calls, opens, activations, saves or cleanup. existingOnly never opens a document. openOwned permits only exact-ID/version owned clean editors in audit/plan/apply; lifecycle effects are receipted. Cold apply requires openOwned before any model mutation; durability:cloud reports coldVerified:false. Preserve targets declared baseline bindings and explicit per-edge pins, not automatic rewind/promotion. latest snapshots each edge's exact target during plan. Historical self-references stay pinned and are excluded from the DAG. Multiple versions of one source, conflicts, external/out-of-scope edges or unrelated version drift block mass update; only a proved edge-specific route may proceed.

sections.title: Methods, bindings and restore boundary
sections.text: Document.updateAllReferences(), DocumentReference.getLatestVersion(), GetLatestCmd, GetAllLatestCmd and UpdateAllLatestCmd are distinct SDK/native routes. Ordinary linked references may use SDK edge/document methods when scope is safe. nativeFallback:qualifiedOnce permits a structurally qualified mixed owned-Derive/linked parent to plan UpdateAllLatestCmd directly, with the existing .11 request-bound lease; never defaults to SDK-first for that planned route. A separately planned SDK-to-native escalation requires a known settled stale SDK result. Unknown/pending SDK results never escalate. Historical SDK-only mixed-parent failure and qualified native success are environment-specific, not a universal Autodesk defect or guarantee. The automatic watcher acknowledges host readiness before command submission. Native polling is lightweight; one post-settlement compute precedes independent version/binding/value/health checks and save. An explicitly mapped value mismatch at an already-current target version is currentVersionBindingMismatch/repairRequired, not a reason to repeat Update All. Current flags or successful computeAll alone never prove propagation. Internal values/units are separate from display values/units (length internal cm, angle rad). Preserve extra local parameters, owned history, consumed-body guards and declared component/body/native-occurrence/proxy attributes. No setSourceEntities, reselect, promote, delete/recreate Derive, alias freeze, source-lineage replacement or repair loop. Broken/unsupported copied feature context is blocked repairRequired, even if cached BRep matches. Same-name upload creates a new file ID; F3Z creates new lineages. DataFile.promote is a separate explicit repair possibility only after equivalence and metadata review, never automatic.

sections.title: Receipts and no-replay
sections.text: Apply journals the request identity/hash before each external action and records source/consumer versions, method, command receipt, save/cloud/cold status, health, metadata coverage, lifecycle effects, completed/skipped/blocked/failed/notProcessed, inProgress, budgetExceeded and continuation. A settled budget stop is partial with inProgress:null and continuation.reason:budgetExhausted; resume with a fresh audit/plan and skip already confirmed current files without resaving. Deadline overrun is separately budgetExceeded. A pending/unknown update or publication stays unknown: do not retry, cancel, restore-save, close dirty editors or continue downstream until the existing request is reconciled. UI dialog acceptance is an action receipt, not model PASS; only actual version/binding/value/health/scope and requested cloud/cold checks set operation outcome.

examples.label: Pinned preserve audit
examples.requires: Replace exact IDs/version with a saved root in the allowed project; use a fresh local report directory. Default existingOnly does not open or activate closed files.
examples.output: Inspect documents/edges, self pins, getter/version evidence, health, scope and coverage. allIntendedReferencesCurrent is separate from allReferencesLatest; incomplete/unknown graph evidence never becomes PASS.

examples.label: Latest plan, bounded apply, inspect receipt
examples.requires: The scope file must be proven reachable. Replace all placeholders, supply exact parameterBindings/uiLeases where required, and create a plan before any apply.
examples.output: Persist planId from this plan result. Invoke phase:apply with that planId, confirm:true and a NEW requestId; then use phase:inspect with the apply requestId/planId to read receipts only. Apply saves only changed same-lineage files and cold-verifies only its own clean editors.

Exact method names and one-shot UI receipt are separate from domain outcome
